description: The invocation-fault record contract held by both writers: the Node writer (src/observe/invocation-fault-log.mjs) and the Rust writer (packages/observe/rust/src/invocation_fault.rs). Both test suites read this file; a row that one writer fails is fixed in the writer, never in the row.

argvShape.name: verb and sub-verb stay, flag names stay, every value keeps only its length
no sub-verb named: only the verb is kept
a second token is a value unless the caller names it as the sub-verb
a second token that differs from the named sub-verb is a value
the first token is kept as typed even when it looks like a flag value
a flag name too long to be one is a value
a flag name of the longest allowed length stays a flag name
an empty value after the equals sign has length zero
only the first equals sign splits the name from the value
a short flag keeps its name
a bare double dash and a name that starts with a digit are values
a plain token that holds an equals sign is a value
length counts UTF-16 code units, so a character outside the basic plane counts two

pathChoice.name: the store the caller resolved is used when it exists
an absent store falls back to the main checkout's existing store
no store argument at all falls back to the main checkout's existing store
a linked worktree records into the main checkout, never into itself
a repository whose main checkout has no store records nowhere
outside a repository with no store records nowhere
